batting.dismissal: c LR Shukla b SP Narine

batting.name: MS Bisla
batting.dismissal: c UBT Chand b A Nehra

batting.dismissal: c UBT Chand b S Nadeem

balls.text: Delhi are all out! the batsman goes for another heave, bottom edges it not too far from the stumps, and there's some confused running, easy run-out at the non-striker's end
and another wicket for Narine, Nehra goes for the midwicket swipe favoured by tailenders, he can't get it far enough, and Delhi have lost nine
quicker, flatter and full, squeezed out towards point
looks to power the ball through the off but can't

looks for the reverse-sweep, and then strays out of the crease, he misses the ball but did he make it back in time? he was really tardy getting his bat back in, think he has made it by a frame, yup he has, Nadeem didn't seem aware that he could have been stumped there
pitching outside off, helped towards short fine leg

another full toss from Lee, this time the result is completely different, Jayawradene looks to make room and chip it over the off side, ends up chipping it to Narine at cover, Jayawardene is distraught at that
and four more, Lee leaking runs here, perhaps someone with Lee's pace isn't the best bet on this sluggish pitch, that was a low full toss and that is thumped towards long-on for four
a monster hit from Jayawradene, that the first Yes Bank Maximum (you aren't going to forget that phrase), a powerful swipe sends that way over midwicket for six
pulls that away towards deep backward square leg, nifty shot that
bangs it in a bit short, Nadeem looks to hammer that towards point but is much too late on that
backs away from the stumps, was looking to hit towards off, somehow gets it away to the right of the bowler
length ball outside off, pushed towards cover

this was coming , Russell really didn't have much of an idea of what Narine was bowling, he closes the face much too early to a legspinner and that lobs up off the leading edge to Narine, who collects that easily, doesn't bother celebrating, just drops the ball at his feet, 'boringly easy this is,' he seems to be saying
spins in from outside off, defended by Russell, who is all at sea here
looking to sweep that fine down the leg side, that was outside off, doesn't connect too well, but well enough to get it past the keeper at least
too short form Narine, spins in and sits up, pulled towards deep square leg
length ball outside off, pushed towards point for a tight single
slower ball, Jayawardene waits for it and thumps that behind square leg for four, a good over for Delhi
a wide from Brett Lee, too far outside off
goes for a murderous hit., a swipe towards midwicket, connects well enough to send it towards deep square leg, gets only a single
skips away from leg stump, deftly pushes the ball towards third man to reach his half-century
pitched up and that is pushed back to the bowler
this time the ball is closer to the stumps, Jayawardene skips to leg just a touch and stabs that behind backward point for four, a controlled hit from MJ
strange shot from Jayawardene, backs away from the stumps and then looks to power the ball through cover, he misses out
guided towards backward point this time
Russell begins last season by whacking his first ball for a humongous six, this time he is bamboozled by the legcutter, no idea which way the ball is turning and he is beaten
stays on the back foot and taps it behind point for a single

Narine is magic in the IPL, how long before the questions over his 1.9million tag crops up, he was much too early into his hoick, sends the ball high and not far at all, Tiwary gets under that at long-off, and Delhi have lost another
clipped towards square leg for a single
chases the batsman who steps past leg, Jayawardene manages to bring his bat across in time to swipe it behind square leg
and again, Pathan punches that back towards Balaji, who moves across to cut that off
length ball heading for middle stump, defended back to the bowler
short of length ball on middle stump, moves away from the stumps and guides that down towards third man
outside off, played towards deep point
on off stump, driven towards long-on for a single
on the pads, helped towards fine leg
length ball on off stump, pushed back to the left of the bowler, Bhatia moves across to stop that
a wobbly slow delivery down the leg side, Jayawardene can't connect with that as he looks to help it down to fine leg
spinning away from the batsman, Irfan pushes that towards cover for a quick single

goes for the reverse-sweep, he misses and that wasn't going to miss the stumps, struck on the thigh pad just outside off stump, and he's a goner, a touch unlucky for Botha, more reward for Bhatia, who continues to be a canny customer in the IPL
Bhatia continues his tight spell, first ball is tapped behind point
full ball on middle and leg, punched towards long-on, Jayawardene makes unhassled progress
slapped behind point for a single

length ball outside off, Botha goes for the sweep, and he top-edges that, he looked around desperately to see where that went, fortunately for him that went over Yusuf Pathan at short fine leg and runs away for four
beaten outside off
was that a drop? yes it was, Botha looking for the straight drive, didn't connect too well, was at a nice height but shukla had to change direction, he goes one-handed at it and misses
short of length ball just outside off, Botha gets off the mark with a guide towards third man

the lack of runs has forced Ojha to go for the bit hit, he steps out and sends it a long way in the air but not long enough, he picks pout Brett Lee at long-off, no problem taking that one, Delhi losing their way here
pushed towards cover this time, another dot ball
length ball outside off, helped towards third man
on the pads, sent away towards deep square leg
dropped towards mid-on for a single
short of length ball outside off, slapped towards point
superbly done there, short of length ball outside off, steered down towards third man
on off stump, a controlled clip sends the ball behind square leg
looks to carve this through the off side, length ball outside off, beaten once more
a rare ungainly shot from Jayawardene, goes for a hoick to midwicket as Kallis drops it a touch short, he misses
just outside off from Kallis, clipped towards midwicket
back of a length ball on off stump, pushed towards cover with soft hands and they scamper a single
punched towards long-on for a single
length ball just outside off, eased to cover for a single
another slower one, just outside off, defend to the off side
and just after I type that, Bhatia bowls one way outside off stump, easy to guide it to the third-man boundary
pushed back towards the bowler, Bhatia continues to bowl at the stumps, not giving any room, his slow cutters proving hard to put away
on a length, punched towards cover for a single, Jayawardene cool and calm
back of a length ball, clips it towards square leg

terrific catch by Shukla, Juneja continued to throw his bat at everything, he skipped away from the stumps and skied that towards deep point, the ball is in the air for ages, Shukla has plenty of ground to cover, he charges in and lunges to take a low catch
Juneja looking to play big shots to every delivery, wanted to whack that towards square leg, top edges it but luckily for him that loops away towards the fine leg boundary for four
Balaji also bowloing slower ones, Juneja was through with a big heave hours before that ball arrived, didn't look good that
back of a length ball once more, just outside off, guided towards short third man
length ball heading for middle stump, Juneja gets back in the crease and tucks the ball towards midwicket
looks to cut and he misses, Bhatia already showing why he's effective on the slow Eden Garden track, a whole bunch of legcutters in that over
Bhatia keeps taking the pace off, that is slapped towards point, no run
confidently played by Juneja, waits for the ball to arrive and late cuts it to third man for a single
again Mahela has to wait for the ball to arrive, works it to the leg side
the legcutter from Bhatia, on a length and on middle and leg, comes on slower than Jayawradene expected, the ball is in the air for a bit as he hits it in the direction of mid-on
starts with a loose delivery, way wide of off stump, Jayawardene reaches out for that and places that wide of the short third man for four
terrific over from Balaji comes to an end, last ball is defended to midwicket
Juneja shuffles across even before the bowler delivers, and then goes for a patented Twenty20 slog, was aiming over mid-off, he misses completely
short and too wide, Jayawardene has it easy, slaps it towards deep point for a single
length ball heading for off stump, 131.8kph, defended by Mahela
short of length ball outside off, worked just behind point
shuffles across and tucks the ball towards midwicket for a single
gets this one to spin away from the right-hander, who defends it to the off side, great start for Narine, pitch offering him something here

there's the impact Narine can have, Warner is gone, that was a tough tough delivery first up for Warner, it spat up off the pitch, a lot more than Warner expected, he edges it through to first slip, where the man with one of the safest pairs of hands, Jacques Kallis, snaps it up as comfortably as he has over the past 15 years
Mahela sweeps that from well outside off, towards backward square leg, where Balaji makes a diving stop
quick offspinner outside off, defended off the back foot
flighted this time, turned towards midwicket for a couple
starts with an offspinner that turns down the leg side, Jayawardene had moved too far across that one
just outside off, warner gets well back and punches the ball towards point, straight at the fielder, and he shouts a loud 'No'
short of length, dabbed towards midwicket for another quick single
length ball on leg stump, defended towards midwicket this time
short of length and outside off, pushed towards backward point and sets off for a quick single, Warner is lightning quick between the stumps, and he makes it in time
better from Balaji, on a length on off stump, defended towards mid-on, 131kph from Balaji
another easy boundary for Delhi, on the pads and that is glanced to fine leg for four, Jayawardene showing what a superb touch player he is
defended towards mid-off to end the over
short of length and on the pads, easy put away for Warner, helped along to fine leg for four more, Delhi making light of that early loss of Chand
on middle stump, short of length, defended down the track
on middle and off, gets back in the crease and makes a bit of room before poking the ball towards cover
length ball on the pads, clipped behind square leg, didn't seem to hit it hard at all but that ball gallops to the boundary, superbly timed
short of length and angling across, Warner looks to stab that towards the off side and he misses
defended towards point

innovation from Jayawardene, superb touch as he dinks a short ball over slips, in total control as he pushes his bat upwards at the last moment to connect exactly as he wanted, one of the most effortless fours you'll see
too side from Lee, easy for Jayawardene to slap it away towards third man, that was 136kph from Lee
length ball on the pads, Warner flicks that authoritatively, but Laxmi Shukla dives to stop that at midwicket
places that towards midwicket, Warner plays that from the crease, making sure he sends it wide of the fielder
keeps it short, dabbed to the leg side for a single to end the voer
Kallis drops it short this time, David Warner is strong on the pull, he dispatches this towards square leg for four, that was 128kph from Kallis
length ball heading for off, tapped towards cover
length ball on off stump, pushed off the front foot towards point
down the leg side once more, Kallis can't get his line right here
quick from Kallis, Jayawardene is not at his most comfortable as he defends that away behind square leg
this time Kallis slides it down the leg side
an appeal for lbw, but that took a thick inside-edge before hitting the pads, good start for Kallis
Warner is away, punishes that through the covers for four, two boundaries and a wicket in the first over, not a bad start at all
better line this time, outside off, back of a length, defended to the off side
that would have been a terrific delivery for a right-hander, for warner it is on legstump, and should have been put away, it brushes his thigh pad through to the keeper
Lee keeps it just outside off stump, Jayawardene is happy to allow that through to the keeper, Bisla - star of the final last season - makes a meal of a simple collection and concedes a bye
pitched up and on middle stump, clipped in front of square leg by Jayawardene, the usual silky touch in place, hardly puts any effort behind that shot but it races away to the boundary

what a start that is to the season, forget Pitbull, this is what people want to see, Lee steams in and fires in a lethal away-cutter, Unmukt Chand is clueless against that one, off stump is reclining on the turf, all those wanting to see Chand will be disappointed, but Lee is jumping for joy
KKR make a winning start, SRK likes that, a single towards midwicket for the single that confirmed the result
opens the face to guide that fine past short third man, scores are level, "KKR, KKR," the crowd chants
looks to chop that one through the off side, bottom edges it and that misses the stumps and goes past the keeper
length ball just outside off, defended, 'well bowled, well bowled, johan,' shouts the keeper
on the pads and that is down towards fine leg, 12 off the over, and Delhi will be wondering why they didn't pick Jeevan Mendis on this pitch which is helping the spinners so much
low full toss on off stump, pushed towards cover
short of length ball on off stump, Yusuf shuffles across and tucks that behind square leg for a couple
swivels as he pulls that short ball towards deep square leg
a ripping delivery from Russell, leaps up at Yusuf who manages to tap it towards point for a single

a huge hit, Yusuf swings the bat cleanly, and connects well, that isn't off the middle of the bat but still has enough to clear the rope, the long-on and long-off fielders were briefly interested but that was too far for them
off the pads towards square leg for two more
short of length ball on middle, clipped towards deep square leg for a quick couple
down the leg side, a free run for Kolkata
whipped towards deep midwicket for a single
short of length and just outside off, pulled towards deep square leg for a single
Umesh is back and Yusuf goes for the pull, bottom-edges it to the off side
full and on off stump, eased towards long-on for a single
Morgan looks to powerfully pull that, horribly mistimed, the ball rolls to the right of the bowler for a single
short of length ball on leg stump, pushed towards midwicket by Morgan
overpitched and outside off, punched towards sweeper cover
goes for the yorker, misses and it ends as a low full toss, sent away down towards fine leg, Umesh nearly made a hash of that as well, but he manages to stop it cleanly
length ball on off stump, defended to the off side by Yusuf
Russell sends down a shortish ball that takes off and goes over Yusuf's head
fired in towards the pads, tucked towards midwicket for a single
spinning away from Yusuf who defends off the back foot
bowled with a round-arm action, more defence from Yusuf
flatter from Nadeem, Yusuf Pathan defends that one

Is there life left in this game yet? Tiwary has been all at sea against the spinners today, he was looking to sweep this time, sharp turn for Nadeem and that takes the top edge, loops to the left of the keeper, who moves across to collect that
whipped away towards deep midwicket
spinning in from outside off, Tiwary is cagey, inside-edges and the ball drops between his pads, Botha posing some questions here
eased off the pads towards midwicket

flight from Botha, Morgan brings out the sweep, connects well and Russell needed to sprint across to get to the ball before it reached the rope, he seemed to have done a great job there, but he just touched the rope as he fielded that
inside-edged on to the pads as he looks to defend off the back foot
length ball just outside off, defended by Morgan who has just faced his first delivery in IPL after a long gap

Botha has struck, is that too late for Delhi, Gambhir was waiting on the back foot, this was flatter and not turning much from Botha, Gambhir misses and is struck in front of middle and leg, would that have gone on to hit leg stump? Perhaps, it would have, Taufel was sure though, and he sends Gambhir on his way

length ball just outside off, gambhir nearly run out for the second time this innings, he pushes the ball towards point and sets off, only to realise his partner isn't interested, a direct hit and Gambhir would have been yards out, the throw misses and Gambhir is safe
a low full toss on middle stump, again Tiwary isn't completely in control as he pushes that towards long-on, Kolkata cruising here
struck on the pads just outside off as he looks to delicately play the ball through the off side
steps down the track, makes a bit of room as well, Russell bowls it short but Tiwary opens his arms and hammers that past cover for four
fuller this time, pushed back towards the bowler
starts with a back of length ball that is defended off the back foot
whipped towards long-on for another single, again low on the bat as Tiwary plays a wristy shot
outside leg stump, Gambhir was looking to make room, bowler followed him, Gambhir still manages to chop that away towards point
short of length ball heading for middle, slapped towards deep cover
swiped off the back foot towards deep midwicket
Gambhir down the track and launches the ball, as he so often does, doesn't connect properly this time, in the air and just short of a diving fielder at long-on
defended off the front foot towards cover
length ball on off stump, driven back by Gambhir, Botha dives to his right to cut that off
again Tiwary skips down the pitch, lofted towards wide long-on
shorter from Botha, Tiwary comes down the track and defends
length ball but Tiwary waits on the back foot for that one, guided towards cover for a couple
Gambhir goes back in the crease and towards leg stump, sends that through the off for another easy single
tossed up, full ball just outside off, eased towards long-on
goes straight on, Gambhir read that though, waited on the back foot and deftly late cuts that past the keeper, that's a test for Umesh at third man, Umesh can't cut it off, Kolkat up to 75 now
looks for the big sweep and misses, struck on the pads
an inside-edge sends the ball towards backward square leg, Tiwary not at ease against Nadeem
on the pads, clipped towards deep square leg
struck low on the bat as Tiwary sends the ball towards mid-on
spinning it past the outside edge as Tiwary looks to guide the ball through the off, plenty of help here for the spinners

once again plenty of flight from Botha and he nearly gets a wicket again, Tiwary is fixed by that one and is early on the shot, ends up lofting the ball towards long-off, was in the air for ages but still lands short of the man in the deep
on the pads, tucked past the keeper for a single
short from Botha, spinning in towards the stumps, clipped towards square leg
skips down and chips it over extra cover for a single
Gambhir waits for that and places it past point for four, in complete control there, staying well back in the crease

Botha nearly gets the crucial wicket of Gambhir first ball, a thick inside-edge as Gambhir looks to force the ball through the off side, just misses the stumps, that was given plenty of air by Botha, nearly got the reward
plenty of spin there for Nadeem, drops it a bit short once more and that turns away from Gambhir a long way, slapped in front of point
poked towards point for a single
thick outside edge as Tiwary looks to play that off the front foot, beats Russell at backward point
short and wide outside off, defended back towards the bowler by Tiwary

Nadeem has struck! with a frankly terrible ball, that was a half-tracker, Kallis could have sent that to any part of leg-side boundary, instead he swipes that straight to midwicket, good catch in the deep, and Nadeem has a big wicket
spin is in, Nadeem bowls, first ball is defended to the off side
Gambhir opens the face and defends that towards point, 140.8kph from Umesh
goes for the pull, doesn't connect well enough, Irfan does well this time in the deep to stop it from reaching the rope
short of length ball outside off, slapped towards point
length ball slanting towards the pads, Kallis calmly glances that down to fine leg where Irfan Pathan makes a miss of what should have been a regulation stop, Umesh grimaces
length ball on off stump, 137kph from Umesh, solidly defended towards the bowler
stays back in the crease and opens the face to guide that towards third man
length ball just outside off, deflects the ball towards point
pushed towards cover this time

back of a length ball outside off, drops it at his feet, Warner was the fielder, Kallis says not to the single, Gambhir is down the track a long way,, he would have been dismissed if that was a direct hit, Warner misses though
short of a length ball outside off, too far outside off, Kallis tears into that, powerfully hit over cover for four, authoritative from Kallis
length ball heading for the pads, tucked behind square leg for one more
mistimed by Kallis towards square leg, an easy single results
short of length ball, cramps up Kallis a bit, Kallis adjust and steers that down to third man for a single
down the leg side, and that's a wide
guides this one towards short third man

width for Gambhir, he loves it there, slapped hard towards point, Nadeem should have stopped that, another lackadaisical bit of fielding and that's a boundary, the point region is packed with fielders but gambhir still finds the gap
length ball on off stump, gambhir looks to thrash that over mid-on, doesn't connect well, but he manages to connect well enough, just over Jayawardene at mid-on and that goes for four
Umesh is on now, he starts with a full ball outside off, squeezed out towards point
well outside off and that is slapped towards point

what a shot from Kallis, a stylish pull towards the deep midwicket boundary, lift9ing his front knee as he plays that, the ball seemed headed for four, but Juneja puts in a spectacular effort, haring after the ball and diving to stop that, or has he? replays show he was just too late to let the ball go, tough on the youngster after an excellent effort
full from Nehra, on middle stump, defended down the pitch
beautiful from Kallis, pitched up and that is pushed past the bowler for four, minimum fuss as he plays that straight drive
length ball heading for off stump, defended from the crease
defended towards point for a single
classic Kallis, a lofted off drive, one bounce and over the rope for four

tough chance for Manpreet at midwicket, Gambhir looked to thump that through the leg side, juneja moves across and dives forward and gets his hands on it but that was too low for him, very difficult that
length ball on off stump, 133.6kph, defended watchfully
Gambhir in a hurry here, another shimmy down the track and that is powered over long-on for six, just clears the rope by a yard
typical Gambhir, skips down the track and launches that over his favourite point region for four, hits it over the fielder there to get a boundary
short of length ball on middle stump, defended from the crease to the leg side
that one reared up, much more than Kallis expected, taken by surprise, and struck on the chest

Bisla is gone, back of a length ball outside, perhaps bounced more than Bisla expected, he was shaping for a big shot, ends up chipping it almost straight up and a host of fielders have time to get under that one, Delhi get their first
backs away from the stumps and carves that past cover for four, powerfully struck by Bisla, but that wasn't the best bit of fielding from Nadeem there, should have stopped it
pushed towards cover off the front foot, Bisla yet to get off the mark
Nehra shares the new ball, defended by Gambhir towards point and he races through for a single
Irfan's started off with a maiden. Short ball angling across, guided to point.
Irfan's not giving much to drive, this was short of a length, and Bisla's pre-meditated midwicket heave ends up inside-edged onto his body.
and again, Bisla marches out, and the ball gets big to hit him on the thigh. Don't think he'll walk out the next ball.
Bisla walks down the track briskly - you can do that at Irfan's pace - but doesn't get to the length of the ball. Played to midwicket.
comes in again from off stump, defended with the movement to the leg side.
inswinger to start off, ducks in from short of a length. Bisla defends from the crease.
